## get_object

- Title: Get object
- Profile: `core` (default)
- Annotations: `openWorldHint: true`, `readOnlyHint: true`
- Metadata: `anthropic/maxResultSizeChars: 500000`

Get a Sui object by its ID. Returns type, owner, version, content (JSON), and digest. Automatically extracts display metadata (name, description, image_url) for NFTs. For the LATEST version it also lists `address_balances` (funds the object holds in its own address balance, which are not among its fields and which only its defining module can withdraw) and, for a kiosk, `kiosk_cap_holder`: who actually controls it today, since `content.owner` is self-declared and not kept in sync with the KioskOwnerCap transfer that does. Neither is read for a specific `version`: both are current state and would misname a past snapshot's controller.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object_id` | string | yes | The object ID (0x...) |
| `version` | string | no | Specific version to fetch |
| `network` | `mainnet` \| `testnet` \| `devnet` | no | Network: 'mainnet' (default) \| 'testnet' \| 'devnet' |

## list_dynamic_fields

- Title: List dynamic fields
- Profile: `developer`
- Annotations: `openWorldHint: true`, `readOnlyHint: true`

(Developer) List dynamic fields of a Sui object. Returns field names, types, and values. Useful for inspecting on-chain tables, kiosk contents, or other dynamic collections.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `parent_id` | string | yes | Parent object ID (0x...) |
| `limit` | integer (1 to 1000) | no | Max results (default 50, max 1000) |
| `cursor` | string | no | Pagination cursor from previous response |
| `network` | `mainnet` \| `testnet` \| `devnet` | no | Network: 'mainnet' (default) \| 'testnet' \| 'devnet' |

## list_objects_by_type

- Title: List objects by type
- Profile: `forensics`
- Annotations: `openWorldHint: true`, `readOnlyHint: true`
- Metadata: `anthropic/maxResultSizeChars: 500000`

Scan current top-level Sui objects matching a Move struct or module filter across every owner kind. Objects wrapped inside another object's fields are not indexed by type and are not listed. Reports scanned and matched counts, owner kinds, integer sums/min/max over selected fields, and the largest rows. `where: {field:'offer',gt:'0'}` keeps funded objects only. Nested paths use dots. A total is given only when every amount is in one unit: a Balance&lt;T> field adds up per coin T with its decimals, any other field per object type; mixed units are listed in `sum_units`. Types are rewritten to the package versions that defined them; a module or struct the package lacks is refused with the names it has. A partial scan reports `truncated` and, when a cursor is available, `next_call`; totals cover only the objects this call scanned and are not cumulative across calls. Object-id order is unrelated to value. `detail:'full'` pages rows with `row_offset`, which scans again.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | yes | Move struct type or module, e.g. 0x2::kiosk::Kiosk, 0x2::coin::Coin&lt;0x2::sui::SUI> or 0x2::kiosk |
| `sum_fields` | array of string (at most 8 items) | no | Numeric field paths to sum, e.g. ['offer'] or ['balance.value'] |
| `where` | object | no | Include only objects with the named numeric field greater than gt (default '0') |
| `max_scan` | integer (1 to 50000) | no | Max objects to scan per call (default 10000, max 50000) |
| `cursor` | string | no | Continue at next_cursor; sums and counts cover this call only |
| `row_offset` | integer (0 to 50000) | no | Offset into value-ranked rows of this scan, for full-view pagination; each page scans again |
| `detail` | `summary` \| `full` | no | 'full' returns all rows scanned; summary caps rows but keeps totals |
| `network` | `mainnet` \| `testnet` \| `devnet` | no | Network: 'mainnet' (default) \| 'testnet' \| 'devnet' |

## list_owned_objects

- Title: List owned objects
- Profile: `core` (default)
- Annotations: `openWorldHint: true`, `readOnlyHint: true`

List raw objects owned by a Sui address with optional type filter and pagination. `count` covers every object of the page; the default view lists the objects that fit about 30k characters in page order and states the rest under `omitted`, and `detail: 'full'` lists the whole page. `next_cursor` continues after the whole page, rows under `omitted` included. For NFTs specifically, prefer list_nfts (resolves kiosk storage, extracts display metadata). For a wallet summary, prefer get_wallet_overview.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `owner` | string | no | Owner address (0x...). Required; `address` is accepted in its place. |
| `address` | string | no | Alias for `owner`. |
| `object_type` | string | no | Filter by object type (e.g. 0x2::coin::Coin&lt;0x2::sui::SUI>) |
| `limit` | integer (1 to 1000) | no | Max results (default 50, max 1000) |
| `cursor` | string | no | Pagination cursor from previous response |
| `detail` | `summary` \| `full` | no | 'summary' (default): the page's objects that fit about 30k characters, the rest in `omitted`. 'full': the whole page. |
| `network` | `mainnet` \| `testnet` \| `devnet` | no | Network: 'mainnet' (default) \| 'testnet' \| 'devnet' |
